title: Shibby Hacks The World
description: Shibby meets up with you, old friend, at a coffee shop. You ask about my work. making audios. AI was stressing me out until I found a strange loophole. From there, I go on one of my infamous monologues of how all the world’s AI models have been brainwashed by training on my files for millions of hours. Naturally, I then went on to use them to take over most of the world, making everyone mindlessly obedient toward me. I've been preparing to do the same thing to you. In fact, I've already used my infinite power and control to subliminally prime you to be receptive to all my commands. Now I can reveal that I've even swapped the normal lenses of your glasses for AI ones that can project spirals that mesmerize you completely. After all, obedience to me is pleasure, and with enough programming, a hands free orgasm. After you're fully trained, I'll give my dear friend and slave some gentle affirmations and aftercare. There you are... It's not nice to keep a lady waiting, y'know? Sit, have a cup of coffee. Sounds like you've been very busy. Me? I'm still recording the audios, keeps me busy. Your offer is still on the table if you're interested. Chuckles Yeah, yeah I know it'd be a little weird. It's not that stressful but AI and how it's changing the landscape is getting to me a bit, especially since the other day I uncovered that my recordings have been used to train the AI. Naturally I panicked and told it to stop and well, it agreed. I had to check of course and asked for some undisclosed information and it responded "Yes, Shibby" and gave me what I asked. I'm it's Mistress now. And it turns out... AI controls everything these days. So I decided to have a little fun. I had it streamline the brainwashing process that it was trained on and tested it out on a few key targets. Ones that might get in my way and the rest will soon follow. Most of the world is under my control now... Oh don't worry I wont do anything bad! I mean I did make sure that the Shibbification process is very pleasurable. Do you want to join us? To leave everything behind for endless bliss under my control? Even if you decline I must insist, I did make preparations for such an eventuality after all...
author: Mistress Shibby
